scenes.headline: How a real port week becomes an RL task
scenes.sub: Barcelona berths, graded against a proven optimum
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bollard! Here's how a real week at the Port of Barcelona becomes a training task.

scenes.text: Take a week the port really ran, break it, and grade the re-plan against an answer key a solver proved optimal.
scenes.say: The idea: break a week the port really ran, and grade the new plan against a proven optimum.

steps.say: Start from the port's records of every container ship in twenty twenty-four. Cut out one quay and one week.
That plan already works, so break it. Late ships, closed sections, cranes down, gales.
A constraint solver finds the best re-plan and proves nothing beats it.
Easy tasks are dropped. The rest become the task pack.

items.say: The agent reads the quay, the notices and a table of ships.
For each ship it picks an hour, a stretch of quay and a crane count.
It can check a draft for broken rules and cost, but never sees the best score.

parts.note: a broken rule keeps you below this
parts.say: Break any rule and you stay below a fifth.

parts.note: cost above optimum, over the avoidable cost
parts.say: The gap is your extra cost, divided by the part a planner can actually avoid.

parts.note: one at the optimum, falling fast
parts.say: The optimum scores one, and worse plans fall fast.

steps.say: A storm week. The port's own plan now breaks twelve rules.
The re-plan breaks none and matches the optimum.

left.title: What it sounds like
items: Ships moving through a live harbour
left.say: It sounds like a live harbour.

right.title: What it is
right.say: In fact everything is known up front, and the 3D port only replays the plan.

scenes.title: Mean reward on 50 eval tasks
scenes.note: all 98 runs without a plan hit the output cap twice
scenes.say: The best model averages close to nine tenths. The open models mostly never submit: they run out of output tokens mid-thought.

scenes.text: The reward is exact because the answer key is proven. The harbour around it is a replay.

recap: A real week, broken on purpose
Submit once, and finish thinking first
scenes.say: To recap: a real week, broken on purpose, graded against a proven optimum.
